生成查询代码
SELECT 
    YEAR AS `年份`,
    FUND_NAME AS `基金名称`,
    FUND_SYMBOL AS `基金代码`,
    ROUND(YIELD, 2) AS `年度收益率(%)`,
    MAX_DRAWBACK AS `最大回撤`,
    SHARPE AS `夏普比`
FROM 
    FUND_STATISTICS_YEAR
WHERE 
    FUND_NAME LIKE '%易方达蓝筹精选混合%'
    AND YEAR = 2025
    AND YIELD IS NOT NULL
    AND HISVALID = 1
ORDER BY
    YEAR DESC
LIMIT 1
